items.title: Apple's 'Servant' Copyright Lawsuit Win Upheld on Appeal
items.description: Apple and M. Night Shyamalan have won an appeal in the copyright dispute over Apple TV series "Servant," with a federal appeals court upholding last year's jury verdict in their favor (via Reuters ).
